variant.briefing:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = [ApprovalCode]

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Calling for a skilled contractor to recover a displaced shipment located at [Location]. Client's hauler was transporting some high value cargo when they decided to respond to a distress beacon and got ambushed by a group of outlaws. The client believes their pilot is gone but their cargo could still be recovered.

The information we have so far is that you'll need a ship that can carry [MissionMaxSCUSize] cargo containers, a heavy-duty tractor beam for shifting the goods, as well as your support ships to help deal with the outlaws at the location. 

Client will be expecting the completed delivery to be made to the freight elevator at [Destination].

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
